text: Never depressurize a hydrate plug from one side only — a pressure difference across a released plug turns it into a projectile that can rupture the line.
Never heat the middle of a hydrate plug — released gas can be trapped and rupture the pipe.
Never force a closed DHSV open against a pressure difference — equalize pressure across the valve first, then reopen through its control system.
Do not keep producing through sustained severe slugging without mitigation — it stresses and can damage well and plant equipment.
Do not base a well-integrity decision on a sensor flagged as frozen or failed.
